verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an Agent SDK for writing customer journeys as code and a CI/CD path for publishing to ChatGPT. Both are agent-authoring and deployment tooling, not a documented public API for driving the product. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt, and no API reference appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
